notes: Address match: certain. The restaurant's own site shows 5201 St Charles Rd, Bellwood, IL 60104 and is single-location. Each section is its own page on the site: /thin-crust, /stuffed-%2F-pan-pizza (Stuffed and Pan are two headings on one page), /panzarotti, /pasta, /special-dinners. All prices were read from the raw page text on 2026-11-10. The Thin Crust, Pastas and Special Dinners pages print prices without a dollar sign (e.g. '12.20'); '$' was added here for consistency. Size ranges are lowest-to-highest of the published per-size prices. The 'Served with bread, salad & cheese' line is a section-level note on the site, repeated per item here. Thin crust toppings description lists only some of the 14 published toppings. Published extras not listed as items: stuffed/pan each extra ingredient $2.80–$5.00, thick crust $3.40–$5.00; panzarotti each extra ingredient $2.30; pasta add meatballs or sausage 5.00. Sections not captured here but present on the site: Thin Crust Combinations, Specialty Thin Crust, Sandwiches, Broasted Chicken, Seafood, Appetizers (verified, e.g. Garlic Bread 2 pieces 5.50, Buffalo Wings 5 for 10.00), Salads, Desserts, Drinks. No online ordering page exists; the site's order button is a phone link to (708) 544-0380. The pages carry no 'last updated' date (footer copyright 2026).
